scenario.summary: Registered user opens the grouped product PDP and checks the breadcrumb, name, SKU, brand, short description, 'Starting at' price, thumbnails and the first included product with its price; head of the class chain.
steps: Open the webstore and sign in with the sheet account
Search the grouped SKU and open the first result
Verify Read Reviews and Home links and the breadcrumb path
Verify name, 'SKU:\n<sku>', brand (not on multistore12), short description and 'Starting at: <price>'
Verify the first included product's name and price
stateChanges: None (read-only PDP; the session stays signed in for the chain)
assertions: Name, SKU, brand and short description equal the product's
Starting price equals 'Starting at: <lowest child price>'
First included product name and price
evidence: Method comment: Z10-TC-8866 breadcrumb, Z10-TC-8867 group details, Z10-TC-8868 included products, Z10-TC-7728 only the starting price shows for the parent. Linked case Z10-TC-7728.

Class chain, first method captures (user decision 2026-11-04): groupProductVerifyProductBreadCrumbPathAndGroupProductDetails declares the product needs and every record value of the chain and keeps the record in class fields; the dependsOn methods read those fields and throw SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when they are null. Consumers: groupProductVerifyCustomFieldAndPersonalizeAttribute (AdditionalInfo -> customFields.additionalInfo), groupProductVerifyPageLinks (Tools label -> product category), groupProductAddProductToWishList (UI text only).

DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): the head method signs in with loginPage.successfullLogin (testClassRetailUsers/groupProductPDPTest Username, Password; loginAndRegistration!B177/C177). An account lease (useExisting) is held by the method that declares it and released when that method ends, so every method that signs in or reuses the signed-in session declares user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store MaxwellsHardware}, preferred {source: its username source, required: true}, with Tda.declareUser at method start. Username/password are credential sources (masked) the test keeps reading from its own sheet.

Params: minPersonalizableAttributes 1 + personalizationAttribute DisplayText because the chain checks the personalization label with the fixed locator lblProductPersonalizationDisplayText (groupProductVerifyCustomFieldAndPersonalizeAttribute); minAddOns 0 (nothing selected; requiredAddOnCount <= 0 keeps Add to Wishlist usable).
